intentionalDifferences: Blank explicit Unit Price column in BOQ input preserves unitPriceUsd: null rather than defaulting to 0 or inferring from other columns.

Unconfirmed 0 price preserves unitPriceUsd: null, requiring explicit provenance (Confirmed Zero Price header, isConfirmedZeroPrice flag, or confirmed service parent contracts HA113A1/HU4B2A3) to treat 0 as known.
Incomplete configurations retain knownOrderSubtotalUsd while setting totalOrderCostUsd: null and pricingComplete: false.
Duplicate SKU consolidation preserves null and records priceConflict (MIXED_PRICING_EVIDENCE or CONFLICTING_OBSERVED_PRICES) instead of silently pricing missing occurrences from later occurrences.
Markdown workload summary formats incomplete solutions as INCOMPLETE with explicitly known subtotal instead of falling back to estimatedCostUsd.
Workbook baseline fallback uses canonical pricing summary helper with outputQuantities callback instead of fabricating 0 total.
